messages.content:
From the Russian news, return minified JSON only: {"e":[],"v":[],"r":[]}. No explanation or repeated fields.
e rows: [id,type,exact_mention]. Named entities only: ORGANIZATION,PERSON,LOCATION,PRODUCT,FACILITY,LAW. IDs e1...; include organizations on both sides and named speakers; deduplicate.
v rows: [id,type,one_short_exact_event_quote,[[entity_id,role]],[[fact_type,exact_value]]]. IDs v1...; include only main events. Roles belong here, never duplicate on entities. Fact types: MONEY (must include currency), QUANTITY (must include a count/measurement unit), PERCENT (must include %), DATE, DURATION. Capture material amounts, counts, dates, durations, percentages.
r rows: [subject_id,predicate,object_id,event_id]. Include explicit links only. Event/attribute quotes must be exact contiguous substrings of the article. Never use metadata as article text or invent facts. Keep to 8 entities, 3 events, 8 relations, 4 facts/event. Example shape only: {"e":[["e1","ORGANIZATION","«Меридиан»"]],"v":[["v1","acquisition","Меридиан объявил о покупке конкурента",[["e1","acquirer"]],[["MONEY","1,8 млрд рублей"]]]],"r":[]}.

{"article":"Заголовок: «ТехноПульс» запустил новую линию аккумуляторов\n\n15 октября компания «ТехноПульс» запустила новую производственную линию аккумуляторов на площадке в Калуге. Линия уже выпускает до 40 тысяч батарей в месяц. В церемонии открытия участвовала генеральный директор Мария Волкова.","metadata":{"date":"15 октября 2026"}}
